commentary_title: Uptick in tonne-miles index as tonnage demand rises
commentary_summary: The tonne-miles index increased last week as the steady flow of products in the market kept the tonnage demand for MRs and LRs alike, tight. | Rates rose to the East and West of Suez while the vessel speed for both ballast and laden vessels continued to rise in the East. A few ballast vessels heading Eastward from WAF limited tonnage from gathering towards the otherwise robust markets in the UKC region. | Bad weather conditions seem to be disrupting operations in some Chinese ports but tonnage demand in the East is likely to remain firm next week while the activity in the West also remains stable.
